function.name: check
function.description: Verify after edits. With path: syntax-check that file (.py, .json, .toml in-process; .js/.mjs/.cjs via node --check; .sh via bash -n) without needing approval. Without path: run the project's own check command, discovered from pyproject.toml [tool.pyagent] check, package.json scripts.check, or a Makefile 'check' target.
